title: Decision: draft-mahy-mls-new-framed-content-tbs-02 is track-only for mimid
description:
Assay mimid-1wgh.44.13 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mls-new-framed-content-tbs-02.txt (280 lines, read whole; sha256 in specs/PROVENANCE).

What it is: extension new_framed_content_tbs (suggested 0x000b, free per Rohan's gist). When required, FramedContentTBS signs context_hash = RefHash(GroupContext) instead of the whole GroupContext (§3 L146-160), so signers and verifiers hash a large GroupContext (e.g. MIMI's participant list) once per epoch. Informational (L7).

How it meets mimid: every signature mimid makes or checks (mimi-mls Member and Observer through OpenMLS, the hub's Observer on PublicMessage handshakes) would use the new TBS in a room that requires it. It is a pure efficiency change: mimid rooms are small, and OpenMLS has no support, so adopting means fork work in openmls framing for no visible gain now.

RECOMMEND: track only. Revisit if a peer requires it, or if large rooms make signature cost matter. The earlier keyword hits (mimid-1wgh.4.68, .37.90.34) are unrelated (AAD on external proposals; partial-02 confirmation tag). No conflict beads.
